# SellMidwestHome

## About
SellMidwestHome.com is a cash home buying operation serving homeowners across six Midwest states. They are local investors — not a national iBuyer or automated platform — who purchase properties directly from sellers as-is, in any condition, with no repairs or agent fees involved. They've completed 500+ home purchases across the region.

## Services
- Direct cash home purchases
- Buy houses as-is — no repairs, cleaning, or staging
- Buy in foreclosure or pre-foreclosure situations
- Buy inherited and probate properties
- Buy during divorce
- Buy homes with deferred maintenance or major damage
- Buy behind-on-payment situations
- Buy vacant properties
- Buy landlord-owned rental properties
- Zero agent commissions and zero seller closing costs
- Flexible closing timeline — as few as 7 days or up to 60+ days

## Service Area
**Illinois** — Aurora, Berwyn, Bloomington, Bolingbrook, Champaign, Chicago, Cicero, Danville, Decatur, Downers Grove, Elgin, Joliet, Moline, Naperville, Normal, Palatine, Peoria, Rockford, Schaumburg, Springfield, Waukegan, Wheaton
**Ohio** — Akron, Canton, Cincinnati, Cleveland, Columbus, Cuyahoga Falls, Dayton, Elyria, Euclid, Hamilton, Kettering, Lakewood, Lorain, Mansfield, Middletown, Newark, Parma, Springfield, Toledo
**Indiana** — Indianapolis, Fort Wayne, Evansville, South Bend, Carmel, and additional cities statewide
**Michigan** — Detroit, Grand Rapids, Warren, Sterling Heights, Lansing, and additional cities statewide
**Missouri** — Kansas City, St. Louis, Springfield, Columbia, Independence, and additional cities statewide
**Kentucky** — Louisville, Lexington, Bowling Green, Owensboro, Covington, and additional cities statewide

## Why Choose Us
They're active buyers in urban, suburban, and rural Midwest markets and understand local values in a way national platforms don't. The offer they give is the amount the seller receives — nothing is subtracted at closing for commissions or fees. Sellers who needed to close fast have closed in as few as 5 days; those who needed more time have taken 60 days or longer — the schedule is up to the seller.
